mobs.name: Creeper
mobs.description: An iconic hostile mob that silently approaches players and explodes. They are the source of gunpowder and music discs when killed by skeletons.
mobs.behavior: Chases players and explodes when close

mobs.name: Zombie
mobs.description: Common undead mobs that spawn in darkness. They burn in sunlight and can break doors on Hard difficulty.
mobs.behavior: Chases players, attacks villagers, burns in sunlight

mobs.name: Skeleton
mobs.description: Undead archers that spawn in darkness. They are accurate shooters and burn in sunlight.
mobs.behavior: Shoots arrows at players from distance, burns in sunlight

mobs.name: Enderman
mobs.description: Tall, dark neutral mobs that teleport. They become hostile when looked at directly or attacked. They drop Ender Pearls.
mobs.behavior: Teleports, moves blocks, hostile when looked at
tips: Wears carved pumpkin to prevent aggro

mobs.name: Spider
mobs.description: Mobs that can climb walls and are hostile at night but neutral during the day. They drop string and spider eyes.
mobs.behavior: Climbs walls, hostile at night, neutral in daylight

mobs.name: Blaze
mobs.description: Flying hostile mobs found in Nether Fortresses. They shoot fireballs and drop Blaze Rods essential for brewing and reaching The End.
mobs.behavior: Flies, shoots fireballs, spawns from spawners

mobs.name: Ghast
mobs.description: Large floating mobs in the Nether that shoot explosive fireballs. Their tears are used for potions of Regeneration.
mobs.behavior: Floats in the Nether, shoots fireballs from range
tips: Fireballs can be deflected by hitting them
Low health - easy to kill if you can reach them

mobs.name: Wither Skeleton
mobs.description: Tall skeleton variants found in Nether Fortresses. They inflict Wither effect and rarely drop Wither Skeleton Skulls for summoning the Wither.
mobs.behavior: Attacks with stone sword, inflicts Wither effect
tips: Looting enchantment increases skull drop chance

mobs.name: Piglin
mobs.description: Intelligent hostile mobs in the Nether. They can be bartered with using gold ingots and won't attack if you wear gold armor.
mobs.behavior: Hostile unless wearing gold, trades for gold ingots
tips: Always wear at least one piece of gold armor
Trading gives Ender Pearls, fire resistance potions, and more

mobs.name: Ender Dragon
mobs.description: The main boss of Minecraft found in The End. Defeating it unlocks the exit portal and End gateway to outer End islands.
mobs.behavior: Flies around the End, destroys blocks, charges at player
tips: Destroy End Crystals first to stop healing
Beds explode in The End - can be used as weapons

mobs.name: Wither
mobs.description: A player-summoned boss created with 4 Soul Sand and 3 Wither Skeleton Skulls. Drops the Nether Star for crafting Beacons.
mobs.behavior: Flies, shoots wither skulls, destroys blocks, has shield at 50% health
tips: Fight in enclosed space like bedrock ceiling
Has armor at half health requiring melee attacks

mobs.name: Warden
mobs.description: The most powerful mob in Minecraft found in Deep Dark biomes. It's blind but detects vibrations and smell. Best avoided, not fought.
mobs.behavior: Detects vibrations and smell, one of strongest attacks in game
tips: Has 250 hearts - not designed to be killed

mobs.name: Iron Golem
mobs.description: Powerful utility mobs that protect villages and can be built by players. They attack most hostile mobs.
mobs.behavior: Protects villagers, attacks hostile mobs, passive to players unless provoked
tips: Build with 4 iron blocks in T-shape + carved pumpkin
Can be healed with iron ingots

mobs.name: Villager
mobs.description: Passive mobs that live in villages. They have different professions and can trade valuable items with players.
mobs.behavior: Trades items, works at job sites, breeds when happy

mobs.name: Wolf
mobs.description: Neutral mobs that can be tamed with bones to become loyal pets. Tamed wolves attack what the player attacks.
mobs.behavior: Follows and protects owner when tamed, attacks when provoked

mobs.name: Cat
mobs.description: Tameable passive mobs found in villages. Tamed cats scare away Creepers and Phantoms, and bring gifts to sleeping players.
mobs.behavior: Sits, follows owner, scares Creepers and Phantoms, brings gifts
tips: Feed raw cod or salmon to tame

mobs.name: Horse
mobs.description: Fast passive mobs that can be tamed and ridden with a saddle. They have varying speed, jump height, and health.
mobs.behavior: Can be tamed and ridden, follows player if leashed
tips: Can wear horse armor for protection

mobs.name: Bee
mobs.description: Flying neutral mobs that pollinate flowers and produce honey. They attack when provoked but die after stinging.
mobs.behavior: Pollinates flowers, returns to nests, hostile if attacked or nest damaged
tips: Use campfire under nest to harvest safely
